name: How long does slip-resistant flooring installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does slip-resistant flooring installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of slip-resistant flooring installation varies significantly based on the type of flooring, the size of the area, and the condition of the subfloor. A small room with basic vinyl tiles might take a day or two, while a large commercial space requiring complex epoxy coatings with extensive subfloor preparation could take several days to a week or more, including curing times. Proper subfloor preparation is crucial for longevity and often accounts for a substantial part of the project timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time depends on flooring type, area size, and subfloor condition, ranging from a few days for small spaces to over a week for larger, complex projects.
